about.title: Spade65 Control Center
about.description: Independent configuration software for the Noir Spade65 non-QMK keyboard.
about.safetyDescription: This application supports descriptor-validated configuration writes. Firmware flashing, bootloader access, raw flash, and arbitrary HID packets are intentionally disabled.
about.privacyDescription: The application runs locally, stores profiles locally, and does not include telemetry or automatic update installation.
common.name: Name
device.intro: Local, open configuration with descriptor validation and safe write controls.

service.title: Background service
service.description: Keep application associations and AP/timeline playback running after the GUI closes.
service.packageNote: This setup uses the current {platform} executable. Keep the release package in a permanent location, then run the blocks in Terminal (PowerShell on Windows).

service.prepareHint: Run this block, then edit {configPath} and replace the example process and profile paths.
service.activateHint.linux: Run this block only after editing the configuration. It installs and starts the systemd user service.
service.activateHint.windows: Run this block only after editing the configuration. It installs {launcherPath}, which starts at the next sign-in.
service.activateHint.macos: Run this block only after editing the configuration. It installs and starts the per-user LaunchAgent.

diagnostics.parityHint: Dormant generic code in the vendor bundle (program association, long/instant press and polling-rate UI) is not an active Spade65 device page or is not serialized by its Jupeng backend. See docs/parity.md.
profile.scopeHint: Nothing is selected by default. Choose only the parts to write. A keymap write follows the official transaction: it reapplies the lighting selected in the Lighting editor and the debounce shown in Settings. Built-in controls select that effect; editing per-key colors selects the custom palette. Successful writes are saved as the profile's active snapshots.
profile.scopeEmpty: Tick at least one part to apply
keymap.originalOptionsHint: Both switches edit the profile only. Press Apply profile to write them to the keyboard.
tester.title: Key tester
tester.description: Press keys on the keyboard and watch them light up here. This reads key events from the operating system, so it works over the cable, the 2.4 GHz receiver, and Bluetooth alike.
tester.hint: A key stays marked once it has been pressed, so anything still plain has not been tested. Fn is resolved inside the keyboard firmware and never reaches the host, so it can never light up. The desktop may also claim the Super key before this page sees it.
